description: The partition Kafka's default partitioner picks for a message key: murmur2 over the UTF-8 bytes, made positive, modulo the partition count — with the intermediate numbers so the result can be checked. Ported from Kafka 4.3.1 and checked against its murmur2 test vectors. Only for messages WITH a key (without one, Kafka uses the sticky partitioner, which is not deterministic).
name: kafka_partition
